answer: Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Reaching the voyage of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on per-epoch sampling audit, split across independent auditors, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. Each submission hangs on the harbor of a task receipt, and the wander is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter.
